Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff — draft MAP + acceptance test catalog (v1)

Lena —

Thanks, attached is a first-pass MAP and an acceptance test catalog (ZenithCare_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key highlights in this draft: 

1) Success criteria (pass = all bullet items must be met):
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for single-turn extraction on dev dataset (seq len 512)
   - Recall/Precision: extraction F1 >= 0.86 across the validated sample set
   - Availability: sustained uptime >= 99.5% during the 2-week POC
   - Cost: avg token cost per request <= $0.015 under baseline load

2) Exit gates (any one triggers a no-go / pause):
   - Repeated regressions in extraction F1 below 0.80 after 2 remediation cycles
   - Latency spikes where p95 > 600ms for > 30 minutes without clear mitigation
   - Security/permissions gaps uncovered in SOC/SIEM evidence review

3) Acceptance tests (automated + manual):
   - Functional: batch of 200 annotated records run nightly with automated scoring (F1/Precision/Recall)
   - Performance: synthetic ramp test to expected peak qps + KV-cache warming test
   - Resilience: simulate model server preemption and verify auto-failover within configured SLAs
   - Security: verify audit-log entries for all requests and KMS-wrapped key usage for at-rest artifacts

4) Fallbacks & mitigation (ordered):
   a) Enable prefix KV caching for verified templates (reduce p95)
   b) Switch to quantized model variant with calibrated quality delta (if F1 drop <= 0.04)
   c) Route non-critical traffic to hosted tier during peak while keeping sensitive workflows on dedicated instance

5) Timeline & milestones (two-week POC):
   - Day 0 (kickoff): baseline run + dataset ingestion
   - Day 3: first smoke functional test and latency baseline
   - Day 7: midpoint demo + evidence pack for audit
   - Day 14: final run, executive report and go/no-go decision (target week of 12/21)

I've flagged items where we need ZenithCare confirmation (dataset ownership, allowed masking level, and preferred failover region). Please review and we can iterate.

Attached: ZenithCare_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Karthik — good structure. Two quick edits from a risk and commercial angle: 

- Metrics: make the F1 threshold conditional by class (some entities will be harder). Proposal: overall F1 >= 0.86 AND per-entity min F1 >= 0.78. Helps avoid outlier-driven passes.
- Add an "acceptable degradation" test in the acceptance catalog: if switching to the quantized variant, run a 100-record blind test and log delta per field; if any critical field drops > 0.06, require mitigation before canarying.
- For exit gates: add a contractual step — if there's a sustained fail condition of more than 24 hours, we escalate to an executive review and pause production access until mitigation plan is accepted.

Operational asks for Priyom: please include a quick note on what evidence pack we deliver for the security review (SOC traces, access logs, KMS audit) so Lena knows artifacts they get at Day 7.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
